text:
alex: Seeing a weird p95 tail spike on llm-13b-prod after the rope_theta tweak this morning. Kernel-selector is falling back to slow_matmul for a subset of requests and flame graphs show KV-cache miss path dominating. cc @maria @devon :eyes:

maria: any trace ids? can you paste a quick repro?

alex: repro command I used:
```
./loadtest --model llm-13b --seq 512 --rps 200 --concurrency 32 --seed 42 --profile=flame
```
logs: `p50=210ms p95=580ms p99=940ms` after change, before it was `p50=205ms p95=420ms p99=880ms`

devon: hmm. fallback to slow_matmul + kv-evict sounds like the selector scoring crossed a threshold. two quick ideas: lower max_batch for short sequences, and increase kernel selector margin so small perf diffs don't flip kernels mid-flight. also maybe prefetch keys for next token if chattemplate pads to 128.

alex: good call. I instrumented kv-evict counts — they jump ~3x in the canary window. suspect rope scaling altered attention offsets so our KV pointer stride got misaligned and caused more partial-cache lookups.

sylvia: I ran a quick config experiment overnight. change set: `selector.margin=0.12`, `prefetch.enabled=true`, `batch.max_short=8` (only for seq<=64). result on canary traffic: p50=212ms p95=460ms p99=900ms. baseline (canary before tweak) p95=525ms. so ~12% p95 improvement compared to bad canary, and roughly parity vs pre-change prod. numbers from 1h window. :thumbsup:

maria: nice. did you check small chat pads? sometimes chat template pads to 128 and makes selector prefer big-kernel which is bad for short queries.

sylvia: yes — added metric `chat_pad_len` and split selector by pad bucket. short pads (<64) now force fused_kernel preference. gave a small bump.

devon: we should also emit `kernel_fallback_rate` and alert if >2% over 5m. that'll catch regressions without manual sleuthing. Add to console and to rollout gating.

alex: I'm going to roll a constrained canary with this config snippet and extra metric: 
```yaml
runtime:
  kernel_selector:
    margin: 0.12
    prefer_fused_for_short: true
  batching:
    max_batch_short: 8
  kv_cache:
    prefetch: true
metrics:
  emit: [kernel_fallback_rate, kv_evict_count, chat_pad_len]
```
Rolling to 5% traffic in 10m.

perf-bot: Canary deployment started for llm-13b (canary-id=canary-20260318-01) :rocket:

maria: Also double-check RMSNorm/SiLU pathing — we have a separate fused kernel for rmsnorm+silu that the selector only picks when head_dim % 32 == 0. variant head dims from model optimizer runs might be nudging us to a slow path.

sylvia: added a quick A/B: enable fused-rms+silu for head_dim==80 (even though not multiple of 32) — microbenchmarks show ~6% gain for common seq lengths. will include that in overnight run.

alex: thanks all. if canary stays healthy I'll promote and add the `kernel_fallback_rate` alert. will post perf graphs later. :rocket:

sylvia: running overnight stress + long-tail capture. will post a follow-up thread with flame images and exact percentiles tomorrow morning.

perf-bot: Canary health checks passed at 15m. kernel_fallback_rate=0.9% (5m window), kv_evict_count down 28% vs bad canary.

alex: great — locking the rollout for 30% while we watch. thx everyone.
